```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(viridisLite)
```

```{r}
#load easter island data in here/data/easter-island
ei_points <- st_read(here("week1","data", "easter-island", "ei_points.gpkg")) |> 
  filter(type == "volcano")
ei_elev <- read_stars(here("week1","data", "easter-island", "ei_elev.tif"))
ei_borders <- st_read(here("week1","data", "easter-island", "ei_border.gpkg"))
ei_roads <- st_read(here("week1","data", "easter-island", "ei_roads.gpkg"))

# also load ei_bathy.tif for bonus challenge
ei_bathy <- read_stars(here("week1","data", "easter-island", "ei_bathy.tif"))
```


```{r}
#Create a map of the outline Rapa Nui using tm_shape() + tm_borders()
tm_shape(ei_borders) + tm_borders()
```
```{r}

            legend.text.size = 0.8,
            frame = FALSE)

#   
#   tm_layout(title = "Rapa Nui (Easter Island)",
#             legend.outside = TRUE,
#             legend.title.size = 1.2,
#             legend.text.size = 0.8,
#            frame = FALSE)

#set to tmap plot mode
tmap_mode("view")

#set the bb to the bathy file
bb <- st_bbox(ei_bathy)
tm_shape(ei_bathy, bbox = bb) + 
  tm_raster(palette = rev(viridisLite::viridis(3)), 
            title = "Bathymetry (mbsl)",
            legend.reverse = TRUE) +
  tm_shape(ei_elev, bbox = bb) + 
  tm_raster(palette = terrain.colors(4), 
            title = "Elevation (masl)", 
            alpha = 0.7,
            legend.reverse = TRUE) +
  tm_shape(ei_borders, bbox = bb) + 
  tm_borders(col = "black", lwd = 4) +
  tm_shape(ei_roads, bbox = bb) + 
  tm_lines(col = "gray30", lwd = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  tm_shape(ei_points, bbox = bb) + 
  tm_symbols(
    col = "red",
    size = "sv",
    shape = 24,
    border.col = "black",
    title.size = "Volcano (sv)",
    legend.size.show = TRUE,
    legend.col.show = FALSE,
    popup.vars = c("Name" = "name", "Elevation (masl)" = "elevation", "Sv" = "sv")
  ) +
  tm_compass() +
  tm_scale_bar() +
  tm_layout(
    title = "Rapa Nui (Easter Island)",
    legend.outside = TRUE,
    legend.title.size = 1.2,
    legend.text.size = 0.8,
    frame = FALSE
  )
```


```{r}
#Switch from the default "plot" mode to "view"
tmap_mode("view")
```

```{r}
#As a bonus challenge, reproduce your multiple-object map from earlier using ggplot2! remove the x,y labels. make sure bathymetry is included
# dont use "scale_fill_terrain_c"

#install.packages("ggnewscale")  # if not already installed
library(ggnewscale)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggnewscale)

ggplot() +
  # Bathymetry
  geom_stars(data = ei_bathy, aes(fill = layer)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", direction = -1, name = "Bathymetry (mbsl)") +
  
  new_scale_fill() +  # new fill scale
  
  # Elevation
  geom_stars(data = ei_elev, aes(fill = layer), alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D", direction = 1, name = "Elevation (masl)") +
  
  # Borders and roads
  geom_sf(data = ei_borders, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = ei_roads, color = "gray30", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Volcano points
  geom_sf(data = ei_points, aes(size = sv), shape = 24, fill = "red", color = "black") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Volcano SV") +
  
  # Titles and theme
  labs(title = "Rapa Nui (Easter Island)") +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colorbar(
      barwidth = 0.5,   # width of the colorbar
      barheight = 6     # height of the colorbar
    ),
    size = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3), 
      ncol = 1
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

```
